integrity: Two standalone deterministic exact-arithmetic enumerations completed; full code and execution output included; verification is self-review, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for labeled regular seven-vertex tournaments only; not a general odd-order theorem. Earlier Brualdi–Li chapter was unavailable in full and priority against unindexed small-order tables is not established. No independent external scientific audit.
title: Converse antipodes in the seven-vertex regular-tournament interchange graph
